title: Jukebox+
description: An interactive jukebox block that extends the vanilla jukebox with a 9-disc inventory, playback controls, and loop modes.
body:
# Jukebox+
  
  An upgraded jukebox that holds up to 9 music discs with a custom GUI featuring playback controls, a progress
  bar, and loop modes. Discs auto-advance when finished and are visually displayed on the face of the block.
  Compatible with any disc mod out of the box.

  ---

  ## Features
  
  - 9-slot disc inventory                                                                
  - Custom GUI with play/stop, previous, next, and loop mode controls
  - Loop Off / Loop One / Loop All modes
  - Auto-advance playlist — skips empty slots, wraps around
  - Progress bar showing playback position
  - Discs displayed on the physical block face
  - Accurate duration detection

  ---

  ## Compatibility

  - Works with any music disc mod (More Music Discs, etc.)
  - Requires **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

### AudioPlayer custom discs now supported! *(1.20.4–1.21.4)*

  Play your own MP3/WAV files through Jukebox+ with full auto-advance support. Requires both mods below:        

[![AudioPlayer](https://img.shields.io/badge/AudioPlayer-159A54?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer)
[![Simple Voice Chat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Simple%20Voice%20Chat-159A54?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat)

  ---

  ## Issues & Suggestions

  Found a bug or have a feature request? Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/kytxii/JukeboxPlus)
